scripts.build: pnpm i18n:check && react-router build && node scripts/check-bundle.mjs && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config build/server/wrangler.json
scripts.typecheck: wrangler types --check && pnpm i18n:check && react-router typegen && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm i18n:check && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts && pnpm test:workers && pnpm test:browser
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm i18n:check && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --coverage && pnpm test:coverage:workers && pnpm test:browser
scripts.i18n:check: lingui check sync && lingui check missing --mode catalog && lingui compile --strict --typescript --workers 1 && node scripts/check-i18n-gate.mjs
